question: Card five of the vision on jaws-v1: Pip-Boy 3000 (equipment; on attack: loot, a +1/+1 counter, or untap two lands) in -- and for what?

contributions.text:
PIP-BOY 3000: NO CHANGE (the doctor, judging Pip-Boy and Monument separately; no shared cut).
- For Mask of Memory, the goldfish reads Pip-Boy worse even as a ceiling (it counts a loot as a free draw): damage @T10 -3.6 [-5.1,-2.2], extra cards by T8 -0.8 [-0.9,-0.7], 13 of 17 rows no call. On the card, Mask is the stronger loot: equip {1}, not {2}; it draws two; Shabraz flies, so "on damage" is usually met.
- For Swiftfoot Boots the goldfish reads 7 rows better (damage +6.6 [+5.1,+8.2], extra cards +1.1 [+1.0,+1.2]) — a ceiling that cannot see hexproof (no removal). Protection is for the A team: not a reason to cut Boots.
- Lizard Blades not tested: it doubles commander damage; multipliers stay.
- Pip-Boy's best mode overlaps Mask; the land-untap mode is a small edge. Not a clear, obvious upgrade over any of the three.
